$comment: Water flow (docs/WATER_FLOW.md, ADR 0053): basins with one level joined by outlets. Rates are real and counted in game time (the day/night clock's: a 20-minute day is 72x real time) x the world's water speed (`speed`, the default of the server's `water_speed`). tickEvery: server ticks per water tick. liveRadiusM: basins within it of a player are simulated, the rest wait. maxBasinCells: a body of water bigger than this (the sea, a large lake) is a fixed reservoir at its level until W2. maxRowCells: a row spreading wider (a sheet over a plain) caps the basin there, the excess lost. streamReach: how far (cells) water running over flat ground looks for a way down before it pools. mergeSeconds: two basins sharing faces merge when the faces would even their levels out within this (water s) and carry what flows through them within 2 cm: a wide gap is one body, a hole in a wall an opening between two. About the shortest flow step the water affords (a tick is up to 64 steps). streamMinFlow: an outlet cell passing at least this (m3/s; 0.05 is a sheet ~7 cm deep over a weir) is drawn running, over its crest and down its way as its liquid's `running` block. catchUpSteps: the most flow steps a water tick spends bringing basins that waited (out of reach, unloaded) forward by the time they waited, the rest the next tick (each step as long as the basin affords; one in balance is caught up at once). liquids: each liquid block's weir coefficient (m^0.5/s; an outlet passes weir x width x head^1.5). leaks: how much a block lets through (m3/s per m2 of face per m of head; a hydraulic conductivity over a 1 m block); a block not listed is sealed. Run `node shared/fluids/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-sim/src/flow.gen.rs is stale.
